newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African rand breaks above 4.60, fresh six-mo low.
newsitem.headline: S.African rand breaks above 4.60, fresh six-mo low.

text.p: 0630 GMT - Rand breaks above psychological 4.60 barrier for first time since January 27 amid small-scale position squaring by local banks after going short overnight due to weekend carry costs.
* Rand last at 4.6020/6050 on dollar from 4.5910/5940 late on Wednesday.

* Dealers say early volumes very thin amid local commercial bank buying, although supply of dollars from London late on Wednesday still in market and expected to help provide support if panic dollar buying surfaces.
* No sign of Reserve Bank which currently in morning meeting, although some traders say it is expected to come in later if neccesary.
* Dealers expect range of 4.5925 to 4.61 for now.
* Bonds idle at overnight levels with R150 last trading at 14.03 pct yield.
